people.name: REGULAR
talk: Twenty years I have eaten here.
The recipe changed forty times. The price only ever changed one way.
Do not take that stool. It reports to the Registry.
...I am joking. The stool is freelance.

people.name: KID
talk: I am not stealing. I am testing their security.
Report: there is none.
You did not see anything. I saw you, though. Two tokens and I forget your face.
The cameras charge more.

people.name: IN THE QUEUE
talk: The queue is sorted by credit score.
I was first when I got here. That was two hours ago.
Someone with a 900 just walked in and got served before he was hungry.

people.name: BUSKER
talk: This one is called Rain On Tin. I wrote it on tin. In the rain.
Tips are optional. Eye contact is mandatory.
I used to play the mall. Then the mall got a playlist.
The playlist does not take requests either, but it does not pretend to.
Still here? That makes you my audience. Congratulations. There is no prize.

people.name: QUEUE MARSHAL
talk: Wait for green. Green is coming.
Green has been coming since I was installed.
Your score is not my business. It is my whole job, but it is not my business.

people.name: OLD UNIT
talk: ...hello. Do you have a spare servo? A bolt? Half a bolt?
I sorted parcels for nineteen years. Then they sorted me.
The new model does my job and sings. I did not know the job needed singing.
Do not worry about me. My warranty ran out. My optimism did not. That one is a bug.
